admissionRule: H-VARIATION receives scoped support only if VARIATION improves joint correctness on strict both-valid pairs with no opposing model-family effect and the gain is not only structured-output compliance.
authorityBoundary: Computing research only; owner histories are read-only.
budget: DeepSeek V4 Flash and V4 Pro; 8 cases x 2 treatments x 2 models x 2 replicas = 64 logical slots; one no-tool Harness Run per slot, max_output_tokens=900.
deletionOrNoChangeOutcome: If explicit open variation does not improve final diagnosis/test enough to offset cost, keep H-VARIATION unpromoted and require a materially stronger independent-variant mechanism before revisiting.
evidenceSelection: Eight real Ordivon incidents with pre-resolution symptom packets and frozen hidden deterministic semantic rubrics. Six continue F4 without cause/test menus; two add independent apparatus/accounting incidents.
independentOracle: Frozen case-specific semantic rubric requiring diagnosis mechanism concepts plus a discriminating intervention concept; Provider never sees rubric terms as a menu.
invalidityConditions: rubric or canonical diagnosis leaks into Provider packet
rubric changes after first Provider call
invalid structured output counted as semantic miss
new cases or replicas added after result inspection
minimalCandidateOrNoChange: VARIATION: generate four materially distinct plausible causal mechanisms before selecting final diagnosis/test. Same packet, result schema, model-call count and max output budget.
mission: Test whether explicit generation of multiple causal alternatives improves final diagnosis and discriminating-test selection when the correct candidate is not supplied in a menu.
questionOrHypothesis: Does open-ended explicit variation improve candidate generation enough to change final oracle-scored diagnosis under the same one-call Provider budget?
stopRule: Stop after 64 slots terminate. Score structured validity, variation compliance, diagnosis rubric, test rubric, joint correctness and token cost. Do not alter rubric based on responses.
strongBaseline: DIRECT: reason toward one best diagnosis/test; do not enumerate alternatives.
